detail.longDescription: I live in a bubble of sorts where most of my coworkers and other professionals in my network default to Zoom meetings. It's glorious—and, honestly, the right way to do meetings. But every now and then, that precious bubble is burst when someone sends me a Google Meet meeting—or specifically requests a Google Meet meeting.
